cmd.copyMcpConfig: Copy MCP Configuration for Other Clients
cfg.registerClaudeCode: Keep the server registered in Claude Code (user scope) automatically, so it is available there without any manual step. Needs the Claude Code CLI.
cfg.language: Language of the interface and of the MCP tool descriptions.
cfg.language.auto: Follow the VS Code language (Portuguese or English)
cfg.serverPath: Path to the tmdb executable. Leave empty to use the one bundled with the extension.
cfg.verbose: Make the MCP server write a diagnostic log (see the server output in VS Code).
